description: Draws a company's income statement, balance sheet or cash-flow statement in the chat as an interactive table the user can switch between. Call it when the user asks to see a statement, or when the statement is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetFinancialStatement returns the figures.

period.description: Fiscal period: FY or Q1..Q4. Defaults to the latest period with line items.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

year.description: Fiscal year as the company names it, e.g. 2023. Defaults to the latest period with line items.

name: ShowFinancialStatement
title: Show Financial Statement
